name: Proving Grounds: Trial of Fear
summary: A Muramite trial arena designed to break the will of combatants through terror, isolation, and Discord manifestations.
description: The Trial of Fear is a segmented arena where Muramite overseers test the psychological resilience of soldiers and captives. The environment is engineered to induce terror: shifting shadows, sudden Discord surges, isolation chambers, and unseen threats. Dragorn captives are forced to confront their deepest fears, while Muramite soldiers must maintain discipline under overwhelming psychological pressure. Discord anomalies are deliberately unleashed to amplify dread and uncertainty.
